title: MT29007: Introduction To Engineering Materials Lab.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Expt. No.Titles of Experiments1Principles of metallographic sample preparation
and observation.2Solidification of metals and alloys, and determination of
phase diagrams.3Observation of macrostructures.4Work hardening and
recrystallization annealing of metals and alloys.5Study of different types of
eutectic microstructures.6Heat treatment of different plain carbon steels, and
their microstructures and hardness.7Microstructures of some commercially
available non-ferrous alloys.8Microstructures, compositions and hardness of
different components used in a bicycle.
